answer: Every identity claims a grove plot on a knoll and locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it carries a parcel down the spiral trail, stamped with a fresh serial. The depot weighs it against the public table: 3% short, a reused serial, or no delivery burns the bond; one courier can't serve many plots, so a rented-courier ring fails. First delivery costs 34, the k-th 34+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,530,500 against a 40,000 pool. Honest keepers pay 34 once.
